shortDescription: Shared ability AI for NPC pawns plus player autocast (in place, or walk into range and back), situational undrafted casting, and per-pawn psycast heat/psyfocus limits. Split out of Entad Framework; Entad and Bastle Framework use it as a soft dependency through gated compat assemblies.
body:
## What it is
The ability AI that used to live in Entad Framework (`Source/AbilityAI/`), now its own mod so Entad Framework and Bastle Framework share one copy. Namespace `AbilityAI`, keyed prefix `AAI_`, Harmony id `saintwacko.abilityai`. Builds 1.6 and 1.7 (LoadFolders, shared `Source/`, per-version csproj under `1.6/Source` and `1.7/Source`, `Source/AbilityAI.Build.csproj` builds both). Krafs refs; Harmony is the only hard dependency.

## How abilities opt in
An `AbilityAIExtension` on the AbilityDef naming a worker class (AoEHostile, AoEFriendly, SelfBuff, Movement, Cover, Recovery, TargetHostile, TargetFriendly, Defensive, Rescue, Calm, Interrupt, Firefighting). Several extensions per ability are allowed and are tried by priority. Each worker has a combat mode (InCombat default; Recovery OutOfCombat; Rescue, Calm, Firefighting Any), overridable per extension with `combat`. Royalty's combat psycasts get extensions from `Patches/AbilityAI_Royalty.xml`: FindMod Royalty, then one PatchOperationConditional per def so a missing psycast only loses its own rule. Friend or foe is decided by the worker's candidate list (ctx.Allies / DownedAllies / Enemies), never by the comps.

## Comp target checks (`CompAllowsTarget`)
`ValidIgnoringRange` asks every effect comp's `AICanTargetNow`. Two vanilla comps refuse any player-faction caster there: `CompAbilityEffect_GiveHediff` (Painblock, Focus, Invisibility, Burden, ...) and `CompAbilityEffect_FireBurst`. While TryGiveJob evaluates a pawn under Control.Player (`curPlayer`), those comps are replaced by their non-player condition: GiveHediff → target is a pawn; FireBurst → target pawn is aiming at the caster. Decided per runtime comp type by which type declares `AICanTargetNow` (cached), so a subclass overriding it is still asked. NPCs, BreakCasting colonists (NPC rules) and calls from outside the evaluation keep vanilla's answer.

## Who casts
- Driver: a postfix on `Pawn_JobTracker.DetermineNextConstantThinkTreeJob`, at most once per 30 ticks per pawn (slower for idle undrafted player pawns, below), plus a global minimum gap between casts.
- NPCs (hostile, non-hostile, animals, mechs; each toggleable): cast abilities a host hook claims, or any ability with an extension when "Also use abilities no mod claims" is on. Factionless casters (manhunters, wild animals) build their enemy list from every spawned pawn hostile to them plus whoever they are fighting back against.
- NPC approach (setting "Walk into range", NPCs only): ranged NPCs walk into range for abilities with `approachDistance`.
- AoEFriendly targeted casts try up to 5 allies, most covered first.

## Player autocast
Modes per pawn and ability, set from a right-click on the gizmo (saved in the `AbilityAIAutocast` WorldComponent; works on shrunk gizmos via Command.GizmoOnGUIShrunk):
- **Off**, **Stationary** ("Stationary Autocast", badge "auto"), **Full** ("Full Autocast", badge "auto+"). Full is offered only for pawns with a drafter and abilities with an extension that has `approachDistance`. In a groupAbility menu, undraftable pawns get Stationary when Full is picked.
- **Drafted**: every worker, only while holding position (Wait/Wait_Combat/Wait_MaintainPosture) or on AttackStatic, never mid-move.
- **Full walk** (drafted, in combat, ranged, healthy, not fleeing/in melee, one walk at a time): uses the NPC TryApproach for Full abilities only. Records a non-saved home cell plus a fresh copy of the AttackStatic it was on. The pawn can cast from its own walk. At the cast, the walk back and then the AttackStatic resume are queued; a walk that ends with nothing castable goes straight back. A player-forced job, undrafting or despawning forgets the walk. A walk back cut short is re-issued up to 2 times, to the same cell.
- **After a Full cast** (setting `ReturnToCover`, default off): "Walk back to original position", or "Find new cover from the ending position" (CastPositionFinder within 6 tiles, must have cover from the nearest hostile; else original position). Chosen once, reused on retries.
- **Undrafted** (setting "Also while undrafted", default on), the worker set by situation (`PlayerSet`):
  - Safe (always): workers that aren't combat-only (`WorksUndrafted`).
  - Fleeing (`IsFleeing`): also Movement and Recovery.
  - All: while fighting back (`FightsUndrafted`) and `ctx.InCombat` by its undrafted meaning.
  - Never while lying down or carrying; only interrupts a fight job (AttackStatic/AttackMelee, queued to resume after the cast) or a casually interruptible job the player didn't order and that is not on the blocked-jobs list.
  - Colony mechs undrafted get the Safe/Fleeing sets only.
- **Undrafted check interval** (`UndraftedIntervalTicks`, default 250, slider 30 to 1200): undrafted player pawns are evaluated at this interval unless `UndraftedNeedsQuickCheck` (fleeing job, or exit-map job with recent harm, or FightsUndrafted and [harmed/attacked in last 10 s, on a fight job, or has an enemyTarget]). Recent harm alone does not count. `PawnState.slowEval` marks a slow wait; drafting, fighting back or fleeing cuts it short. Drafted pawns and NPCs stay at 30.
- **Blocked jobs** (`AbilityAIBlockedJobs`, `Dialog_BlockedJobs`): jobs undrafted autocast won't break off. 40 defaults (meals, recreation, gatherings, rituals, childcare, learning; Core/Ideology/Royalty/Biotech/Anomaly, all casualInterruptible, verified). VisitSickPawn, PilotConsole, TradeWithPawn, ReadDatacore deliberately off. Saved as a diff from the defaults (`abilityAI_blockedJobsAdded` / `Removed` defName lists), so new defaults reach existing players and names from unloaded mods are kept and ignored rather than dropped. Resolved lazily into a `bool[]` by JobDef.index (one array read per check). The window (button "Jobs not to interrupt (n)..." under the interval slider) lists every casualInterruptible JobDef except the fight jobs, checked first; search, "Checked only", reset; rows keep their place when ticked until the next rebuild; only visible rows drawn. Mockup `.circinus/mockups/blocked-jobs-window.html`.
- Animals: the menu needs the ability gizmo visible undrafted, which is the host's `displayGizmoWhileUndrafted`.
- Player pawns in a mental break act as NPCs only with BreakCasting on.

## Psycast limits (per pawn)
A gizmo after vanilla's psyfocus one (Order -99), only for a single selected player pawn with a psychic entropy tracker and at least one real `Psycast` set to a non-Off mode (answer cached 60 frames). Two drag bars in 5% steps: "Max heat" and "Min focus". No reset button: dragging both handles to the ends restores the defaults. Stored in the same world component only when different from the defaults. The rule (`PsycastWithinLimits`) skips a psycast whose heat gain would push heat past cap × max, or whose psyfocus cost would bring psyfocus under the floor; checked with the cheapest cost while picking candidates and with `FinalPsyfocusCost(target)` after targeting. Real Psycasts only; NPCs have no limits.

## Host API (soft-dependency contract)
Hosts must keep all references to this assembly in a compat DLL loaded via `IfModActive="saintwacko.AbilityAI"`.
- `AbilityAIHooks.Register(IAbilityAIHook)`: Vote Claim/Veto/NoOpinion per pawn+ability, and Notify_AICast.
- `AbilityAIInfo.Register<T>(radius, hediff, stuns)`: describes a host's own effect comp to the workers.
- `AbilityAIDriver.Handles(pawn, ability)`: whether this mod is deciding for that pair (undrafted: `UndraftedReach`).
- `AbilityAIDriver.OthersStandDown(pawn, ability)`: what the vanilla stand-down uses.
- `AbilityAIDriver.Valid/ValidIgnoringRange` are public but apply the player comp rules only inside an evaluation.

## Vanilla stand-down
A postfix on `Ability.AICanTargetNow` returns false whenever `OthersStandDown` is true (setting "Replace vanilla's casting", default on).

## Settings
Own settings page (`AbilityAIMod`): enabled, per pawn kind, unclaimed, vanilla stand-down, NPC approach, player autocast, also while undrafted (+ check interval slider + blocked jobs window), show marker, after-Full-cast destination, break casting, min gap slider, dev debug log, reset (also resets blocked jobs).

## Autocast badge and marker
Full-size gizmo: second text line on the left. Shrunk gizmo: bottom left. When the mode is Off but the menu is available (`Offers`, cached per Ability 60 frames), a small grey ring (`AutocastMarker`, setting `ShowMarker`). Tooltip gets "Right-click to set autocast (now: X)" via a postfix on `Command.DescPostfix`.

## Handoffs
`.circinus/handoff/entad-framework.md`, `.circinus/handoff/bastle-framework.md`, `.circinus/handoff/player-autocast-plan.md` (steps 3 to 5 done), `.circinus/handoff/next-steps.md` (bug fix, A, B done in builds 0020 to 0024; untested in game).
